servers.github: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, files and Actions.
servers.slack: Slack workspace messaging: channels, threads, users and files.
servers.jira: Jira issues, sprints, boards and worklogs.
servers.stripe: Stripe payments: customers, payment intents, refunds, invoices, subscriptions.
servers.postgres: PostgreSQL database: queries, schema inspection, indexes and diagnostics.
servers.s3: Object storage (S3-compatible): buckets, objects, presigned URLs, lifecycle.
servers.sentry: Sentry error monitoring: issues, events, releases.
servers.datadog: Datadog observability: metrics, monitors, logs, dashboards, incidents, events.
servers.notion: Notion pages, databases, blocks and comments.
servers.linear: Linear issue tracking: issues, teams, projects, cycles, labels.
servers.email: Mailbox (IMAP/SMTP): send, search, reply, organize messages.
servers.websearch: Web search and page fetching, plus small utilities (translate, currency, definitions).
servers.confluence: Confluence wiki: spaces, pages, labels, comments.
servers.ci: CI/CD: pipelines, jobs, logs, artifacts, environments, variables.
